protected_scope.governance_digest_recipe: sha256 of UTF-8 manifest lines '<file_sha256>  <path>\n', with git ls-files data/raw data/derived plus PREREGISTRATION.md, CLAIM_INVENTORY.md, and the eight fixed Stage-0 through Stage-3 receipt files, sorted by UTF-8 path bytes; this JSON is outside the scope and therefore does not recurse

decimal_conversion.numeric_type: Decimal parsed directly from the ASCII lexical token; no binary float
decimal_conversion.kilometre_conversion: Decimal(height_raw) * Decimal('1000') exactly after inclusive Decimal bounds checks
decimal_conversion.metre_conversion: Decimal(height_raw) exactly after inclusive Decimal bounds checks
decimal_conversion.canonical_metres: format(value, 'f'), strip trailing fractional zeros and a trailing decimal point, map empty or -0 to 0

anomaly_value_schema.group_order: UTF-8 byte order of the declared group-key tuple; members are source_ordinal ascending
anomaly_value_schema.blank_extra_cells_semantics: one record per blank trailing cell, not one record per affected row

kilometre_conversions.record_type: one record per accepted decimal-kilometre token

height_raw.semantics: accepted decimal-kilometre lexical token exactly as parsed

metre_conversions.record_type: one record per accepted integer-metre token

height_raw.semantics: accepted integer-metre lexical token exactly as parsed

repeated_casefold_name_groups.inclusion: groups with two or more source rows

name_casefold.semantics: NFKC collapsed-whitespace mountain name after Unicode casefold

same_name_different_height_groups.inclusion: groups with two or more distinct canonical_metres values

name_casefold.semantics: NFKC collapsed-whitespace mountain name after Unicode casefold

members.semantics: source-ordinal ascending members with at least two canonical metres values

exact_name_height_groups.inclusion: groups with two or more source rows

name_casefold.semantics: NFKC collapsed-whitespace mountain name after Unicode casefold

height_tie_groups.inclusion: groups with two or more source rows

source_order_inversions.record_type: one record for each adjacent ordinal pair whose elevation strictly increases

next_source_ordinal.semantics: one-based immediately following target-table data-row ordinal

previous_canonical_metres.semantics: canonical Decimal metres text before inversion

next_canonical_metres.semantics: canonical Decimal metres text after inversion and strictly numerically greater

missing_fields.record_type: one record per missing required field in header order Mountain, Height, Country, Continent

field.semantics: missing required field in target-header order

blank_extra_cells.record_type: one record per trailing cell whose raw text is empty or whitespace-only; column_index is one-based

cell_text.semantics: raw blank or whitespace-only trailing cell text

nonblank_extra_cells.record_type: one record per trailing cell whose raw text is not whitespace-only; column_index is one-based

cell_text.semantics: raw trailing cell text whose stripped value is nonempty

anomaly_value_schema.hard_fail_observation_rule: diagnostic classification is deterministic before enforcement; a missing required field or nonblank extra cell then hard-fails and produces no fit receipt

parser.target_table_rule: exactly one table whose first four normalized cell texts equal target_headers
parser.name_normalization: Unicode NFKC then collapse every whitespace run to one ASCII space; casefold only for comparison
parser.expected_url_status: frozen documentary provenance metadata; it is not inferred from HTML bytes

historical_current_mapping.exact_pairing: exhaust one-to-one pairs within each exact key before any name-only pairing
historical_current_mapping.same_name_different_height_pairing: pair remaining rows one-to-one within normalized_casefold_name in ascending source ordinal after exact pairing; paired canonical metres must differ

historical_reconstruction.source_evidence: results/scaruffi-source-audit.md; independently dated Arquivo.pt 2009-10-08 capture, which supplies 555 target rows
historical_reconstruction.rank_convention: paper describes n=1 as Everest while inverse count adds one for numeration; this convention is not uniquely resolvable from the paper and must be reported rather than chosen post hoc
historical_reconstruction.fitting_objective: not stated by Miškinis (2011); no objective, weighting scheme, or optimizer is inferred
historical_reconstruction.parameter_constraints: not stated by Miškinis (2011); no unstated constraints may be inferred
historical_reconstruction.residual_statistic: residual mean and standard deviation against the printed rank curve
historical_reconstruction.model_family: Miškinis exponential rank curve, plus the printed power comparator only as a separately labelled comparison
historical_reconstruction.cutoff_treatment: fit the fixed complete 555-row as-archived candidate only; no top-548, deletion, mapping-based, or benchmark-based membership operation is permitted
historical_reconstruction.comparison_statistic: printed power/exponential standard-deviation and correlation comparison, retaining its N=540/N=548 label inconsistency

recipe_identifiability.reason: the paper does not specify a fitting objective, weighting scheme, coefficient constraints, optimizer, or enough detail to choose a unique rank-origin convention

benchmarks.continuous_tolerance_rule: half one unit in the final printed decimal place

table1.printed_arithmetic_inconsistency: 548-53=4 is preserved as printed and is not corrected

historical_reconstruction.fit_interpretation: archival sensitivity evidence rather than replication
historical_reconstruction.future_change_requirement: only a separately owner-approved dated deviation with independent 548-row membership evidence and unique-recipe evidence may define a different candidate or disposition

arms.label: Scaruffi 2026-09-03 exact-duplicate-only sensitivity
arms.membership: retain the earliest source ordinal for duplicate key (normalized_name.casefold(), elevation_m); expected 564 rows

current_snapshot.allowed_interpretation: dated elevation-selected follow-up sensitivity only; it cannot upgrade or overwrite any original Stage-3 verdict lane

row_identity_encoding.serialization: json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')) + '\n', UTF-8, then SHA-256
row_identity_encoding.canonical_metres: format(value, 'f'), strip trailing fractional zeros and trailing decimal point, map empty or -0 to 0
row_identity_encoding.text_normalization: Unicode NFKC then collapse whitespace; name is casefolded, country and continent are not

private_trace.mapping_assignment_order: category precedence exact, same_name_different_height, historical_only, current_only; then historical ordinal or 0, then current ordinal or 0
private_trace.membership_fingerprint_encoding: SHA-256 of newline-terminated compact UTF-8 JSON array ['scaruffi-membership-fingerprint-v1', [historical row_sha256 values in source_ordinal order]]
private_trace.mapping_fingerprint_encoding: SHA-256 of newline-terminated compact UTF-8 JSON array ['scaruffi-mapping-fingerprint-v1', ordered mapping assignment objects]

included_historical_source_ordinals.semantics: all included one-based historical source ordinals

historical_ordinal.semantics: one-based source ordinal or null for the absent side

current_ordinal.semantics: one-based source ordinal or null for the absent side

current_row_sha256.semantics: lowercase SHA-256 row identity or null for the absent side

production.row_coverage_rule: one row identity per source ordinal; historical source_id/capture identity binds arquivo_pt_20091008014619 and current binds scaruffi_20260903_current
production.row_identity_encoding_rule: each row_sha256 equals the prescribed compact UTF-8 newline-terminated row identity encoding
production.assignment_partition_rule: each row identity appears exactly once; category determines present historical/current sides and lookup hash equality
production.aggregate_count_rule: candidate_rows equals included historical rows; category counts equal mapping assignments
production.fingerprint_rule: membership and mapping fingerprints equal their prescribed compact UTF-8 newline-terminated encodings

synthetic.row_coverage_rule: historical and current source ordinals are unique; each row list is source_ordinal ascending
synthetic.row_identity_encoding_rule: each row_sha256 equals the prescribed compact UTF-8 newline-terminated row identity encoding
synthetic.assignment_partition_rule: each row identity appears exactly once; category determines present historical/current sides and lookup hash equality

synthetic.fingerprint_rule: membership and mapping fingerprints equal their prescribed compact UTF-8 newline-terminated encodings
